claim.text: redact_and_save / redact_and_save_with / redact_and_save_opts with the default StructureTreePolicy::Strip: when at least one region is flattened, the strip UNLINKS only (lead diagnosis DIAG-PRESS-R27): it removes the catalog's /StructTreeRoot and /MarkInfo, every /StructParents, /StructParent and /SE entry of every dictionary and the /SD of every GoTo action (/S the name GoTo, written directly or as a reference that resolves to it, through alias objects too; R28-S2), and deletes no object. The save writes only the objects reachable from the trailer /Root and /Info (writer::write_document over writer::reachable), so structure-tree objects that only these entries reached are not in the saved file. An object anything kept still reaches (an /AcroForm, an annotation, an optional-content group, an action, an outline item, a private catalog key, an object stream or alias kept as such) stays unchanged, structure-shaped or not; structure objects still written after the strip are reported NotProven (key-based closed set from the original tree; lead diagnoses DIAG-PRESS-R28 and DIAG-PRESS-R29): before the unlink the strip records every object reachable from the original catalog /StructTreeRoot through every key, except the outward keys where they point out of the tree (R30: /Pg of a structure element, /Pg /Stm /StmOwn of a /Type /MCR, /Pg /Obj of a /Type /OBJR, each only when reached as structure through the root, /K /P /Ref or the parent/id tree nodes /Kids /Nums /Names); class maps, role maps, attribute objects of any owner, namespaces, associated files and everything they reach are walked on every key, a class, role or attribute named Obj, Pg, Stm, StmOwn or S included; no type, /Subtype, shape or depth exclusion (iterative walk, visited set with re-expansion as data; the catalog and the pages are not entered; a /StructTreeRoot that resolves to a dictionary without /Type /StructTreeRoot and without any root key /K /ParentTree /IDTree /ClassMap /RoleMap /ParentTreeNextKey /Namespaces /PronunciationLexicon /AF names no tree, R30-S3), and check_document counts it (region_flattened false, NotProven::ResidualInRegion) when the saved file still holds any of them, as an object or as a member of an object stream it holds as a stream, whatever its shape; an object a kept path shares with the tree counts too (over-count, fail closed; e.g. R27 X3, a URI action named in the root's /K and kept by a link, reads NotProven since d43fd4e). The walk is bounded only by an object-count budget (Limits::max_objects); budget exhaustion fails closed (counted). The shape rules of check_document stay as an additional net (a dictionary holding /ParentTree /IDTree /ClassMap /RoleMap or /ParentTreeNextKey, an element or root shape). Residual (accepted, PLR-103 remainder): an element-like dictionary that the original tree does not reach through any key and that has no element shape is neither in the closed set nor shape-counted. RedactedOutput::losses is [AccessibilityTagsRemoved] only when a structure entry was unlinked from an object the saved file holds and its value resolves: the catalog's /StructTreeRoot resolving to a dictionary with /Type StructTreeRoot, or without /Type holding /K or a root key; or a /StructParents, /StructParent, /SE or /SD whose value is not null (a reference to no object reads as null). Not for /MarkInfo alone (R26-S4), not for a /StructTreeRoot naming no object or a non-root dictionary (R27-S3). A tagged document whose tree only those entries reached reads region_flattened / region_cleared / is_proven. Content streams are unchanged (marked-content operators with /MCID stay). StructureTreePolicy::KeepNotProven keeps the pre-D28 behaviour. A save with no region strips nothing.

remediation_R28.design: flatten_purge.rs: Stripped {removed, tree}; TreeRole (Root, Element, Kid, NumTree, NameTree, ClassMap, Owned, Leaf), tree_child (key -> role; /Pg /Obj /Stm /StmOwn /AF not followed), tree_admits (no stream, no outside_tree dictionary; Root needs root_shaped; Element/Kid need element_like (/Type StructElem, or no /Type with /S name and /P or /K) or MCR/OBJR; Leaf admits no dictionary), structure_tree_objects (iterative, each object once, depth_cap, cancel every 1024 steps, catalog and pages excluded by number). check_document(saved, flat_pages, flattens, tree): structure |= any tree member in saved.objects; Scan::object_stream counts a header member number in the tree. Object numbers are preserved by the writer (writer.rs write_document writes each live object under its own number) and canon/flatten allocate above the highest existing number, so a written member number is the same object.
